name: Warfare Of Saints
overview: The warfare of the saints is depicted as a spiritual battle where God is the source of strength and deliverance. Believers are called to be courageous and confident, trusting the Lord as their light and salvation even when enemies surround them, as shown in Psalms 27. The Psalmist encourages waiting on the Lord for courage and strength, affirming that God’s help comes from His sanctuary, providing support amid trials. This warfare is not merely physical but involves faith and reliance on God’s righteousness and protection.
